scores.key_signal: HOMB's asset-sensitive balance sheet and 4.50% NIM expansion make it a rare rate-hike beneficiary among regional banks, but net loan contraction due to payoffs and borrower hesitation signals softening credit demand in the broader economy.
scores.name: Home Bancshares, Inc. (Arkansas)

scores.key_signal: Global aluminum inventories at a historically low ~42 days of consumption with Alcoa's order book 'significantly less available' than a year ago signals persistent physical tightness and strong near-term pricing power outside China.
scores.name: Alcoa Corp.

scores.key_signal: Record 78% pre-tax margin sustained despite Fed rate cuts, driven by 30%+ account growth and 18% DART expansion, signaling robust structural demand for equity market access globally.
scores.name: Interactive Brokers Group, Inc.

scores.key_signal: USB's record $8B revenue with positive operating leverage expanding to 300bps and accelerating loan/deposit growth signals broad banking sector expansion driven by rate tailwinds and recovering credit demand, though reserve build and paused buybacks inject forward caution.
scores.name: U.S. Bancorp

scores.key_signal: Broad-based loan and deposit growth of 11% YoY, surging capital markets activity (M&A +30%, ECM +33%), and accelerating consumer spending signal robust US economic expansion, though sustained headcount reduction (-8% YoY, -30% from peak) flags a structural deflationary impulse for financial services employment.
scores.name: Wells Fargo & Co.

scores.key_signal: Industrial real estate fundamentals are solidifying with 38% net effective rent growth on rollover and a 27% replacement cost premium creating a structural floor against new supply, even as rising Treasury yields are compressing transaction volumes and widening bid-ask spreads on asset dispositions.
scores.name: Prologis, Inc.

scores.key_signal: BlackRock's $205 billion Q3 net inflows and ninth consecutive quarter of 5%+ organic base fee growth signal robust, broad-based institutional demand for capital deployment across private markets, infrastructure, and AI financing — a leading indicator of sustained asset management sector expansion.
scores.name: BlackRock, Inc.

scores.key_signal: JPMorgan's $539M reserve build combined with explicit tightening of internal credit standards signals management is pre-positioning for late-cycle credit deterioration, even as current consumer and corporate activity remains resilient.
scores.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

scores.key_signal: US same-store sales grew only 0.3% with items-per-order declining — a classic late-cycle consumer stress signal — while Domino's cut US net new store guidance, flagging franchisee profitability strain that could persist into 2027.
scores.name: Domino's Pizza, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Citi's best third-quarter revenue in a decade, up 8% YoY with broad-based institutional momentum in capital markets, trade, and wealth inflows, signals healthy global corporate activity despite management's defensive reserve build anticipating potential labor market deterioration.
scores.name: Citigroup, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Goldman Sachs's record M&A advisory revenues, near-record equities performance, and raised AWM fundraising guidance to $150B signal a fully reignited deal cycle and broad institutional capital deployment, representing a strongly expansionary macro backdrop for financial services.
scores.name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.

scores.key_signal: JNJ's $100B revenue milestone and raised 2026 guidance signal durable pharma-led growth, but MedTech underperformance driven by China VBP and Middle East disruptions reveals systemic geopolitical headwinds for the broader medtech sector.
scores.name: Johnson & Johnson

scores.key_signal: Identical sales declined 0.8% with explicit lower-income consumer trade-down accelerating and persistent cost-side inflation creating a stagflationary squeeze on mid-to-low income U.S. consumers, signaling broad consumer wallet compression.
scores.name: Albertsons Cos., Inc.

scores.key_signal: PNC's C&I loan growth of 17% YoY and record expansion market client onboarding signal robust corporate credit demand, though two additional expected Fed hikes pose a meaningful risk to the forward pipeline.
scores.name: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc.

scores.key_signal: Record $190B in core net new assets (+38% YoY) with ~6% organic growth rate and 29% EPS growth signals a strong brokerage earnings cycle significantly outperforming consensus, pointing to robust household wealth accumulation and risk appetite.
scores.name: The Charles Schwab Corp.

scores.key_signal: Morgan Stanley's record $232B quarterly net new assets and 41% equities revenue surge driven by AI CapEx supercycle signal strong financial sector expansion, though rising global interest rates and geopolitical tensions are creating meaningful headwinds for investment banking deal completions and NII monetization into year-end.
scores.name: Morgan Stanley

scores.key_signal: Broad-based commercial loan growth of 8% YoY across every segment combined with raised NII guidance to ~8% for 2026 and '8% or more' for 2027 signals sustained business investment expansion and a rate-hiking cycle consensus that is bullish for US economic activity.
scores.name: Bank of America Corp.

scores.key_signal: Southeast regional bank credit demand remains robust with 9.7% annualized loan growth and 11.2% customer deposit growth, but NIM compression of 12 bps and rising deposit repricing costs signal that funding pressure will weigh on bank profitability heading into Q4 2026 and 2027.
scores.name: FB Financial Corp.
